THE VOICE YOU CAN SEE

Simple type.
Strong expression.

Inter is the proposed shared family for Latin text. Primary headlines use Bold or ExtraBold. Secondary body copy uses Regular. UI labels use Medium or SemiBold. These are different roles within the same font family.

PRIMARY / HEADLINES

Inter ExtraBold

Bold 700 · ExtraBold 800
Everyday,
made easier.

Campaign headlines, hero titles and key messages. Large, bold and instantly recognizable.

SECONDARY / BODY COPY

Inter Regular

Regular 400
Familiar at every tap.

Clear information, familiar words and enough room to read. Use this lighter weight for paragraphs, descriptions and supporting content.

Body copy · 16 px · 1.5 line height

01

English + Hinglish

Use natural phrasing and sentence case. Avoid extended all-caps paragraphs.

02

Regional scripts

Noto Sans Devanagari is proposed for Hindi. Confirm suitable script fonts for Gujarati and Odia before release.

03

Proof every language

Review matras, Unicode shaping, line breaks, spelling and text expansion with a regional editor.
